# Which CI race job runs each package: race (1), race (2) or race (3).
# One line per package of `go list ./...`: <shard> <import path>.
# Every package must be in exactly one shard; `bash .github/race-shards.sh check`
# enforces it in each race job. Rebalance by moving lines, never by adding
# shards (docs/decisions/ci-race-shards.md). The timings behind this split are
# in docs/evidence/ci-race-shards-2026-11-timings.md; the five slowest packages
# (cli, launch, interp, cmd/guildhall, artisan) are kept apart.

# Shard 1: internal/cli, the slowest package, with three mid-sized ones.
1 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/cli
1 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/forge
1 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/git
1 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/store

# Shard 2: internal/launch and internal/artisan.
2 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/adapter/claude
2 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/artisan
2 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/herdr
2 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/launch
2 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/release
2 github.com/ndrwl/guildhall/internal/steward
